Captains must manage main battery gunnery, secondary anti-aircraft fire, torpedo salvos, damage control crews, compartment flooding, and fire suppression while navigating open ocean waters and island archipelagos. Naval battles seamlessly integrate aerial attacks from torpedo bombers and dive bombers, creating dynamic naval skirmishes.

Helicopter pilots utilize terrain masking, hovering behind tree lines and ridge lines, to fire long-range ATGMs at enemy armor while evading enemy surface-to-air missile (SAM) radar threats.
